title: Project Mohole
text: In 1961 an American drilling barge, CUSS I, bored into the floor of the Pacific off Guadalupe Island: the first test of a plan to drill through the crust to the boundary geologists call the Moho. The cores were famous for a season. Congress cancelled the project in 1966. Officially, nothing came up from Guadalupe deeper than basalt. Officially, nothing went down.
teaser: A Pacific core canister turned up in a dry cavern.
